dedupe_keys.name: emprises des parkings de plus de 1500 m2

description: Emprises des parkings de plus de 1500 m² is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. Couche des emprises des parkings de plus de 1500 m² en 2021 sur le périmètre de la région Île-de-France. Un potentiel solaire a été estimé sur chaque parking de la couche. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports, Cadre de vie - environnement. Its keywords are Parking, Stationnement. The portal shows 7,542 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
